title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. translated_title: LEASH：面向计算机使用代理的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
translated_abstract: 计算机使用代理越来越多地处理长时程任务，在这类任务中，每一步都运行前沿模型成本高昂，而仅靠小型开源权重模型又往往失败。弱到强升级提供了一种折中方案：默认由弱代理执行任务，仅在需要时将控制权移交给强代理。核心挑战在于决定何时进行升级，这需要一个足够廉价、能在每一步都进行检查的不确定性信号。然而，即使完成移交之后，强代理仍可能迷失方向，但强代理通常所使用的黑盒API并不暴露任何可供监控的内部信息。为此，我们提出了LEASH，这是一个无需训练的框架，只有当弱代理的潜在不确定性表明需要时才释放强代理，并在其后对其保持约束。LEASH包含三层：（1）用于早期路由的初始任务不确定性，（2）用于运行时升级的步骤级不确定性，以及在移交之后（3）用于持续监督的影子观察器……
tldr: LEASH提出了一种无需训练的弱到强升级框架，通过弱代理的多层不确定性信号（任务级、步骤级和影子观察器）来决定何时将计算机使用任务移交给强代理并持续监督，从而在成本与性能之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: LEASH is a training-free framework that leverages multi-level uncertainty signals from a weak agent—task-level routing, step-level escalation, and a shadow observer—to decide when to hand off computer-use tasks to a strong agent and keep it under oversight afterward.
